title: China’s AI Rollout Has No Off Switch
gist: Demarais argues Washington measures the AI race by frontier benchmarks while Beijing measures adoption and diffusion, via industrial data, industrial AI agents, embodied robots and cheap open-weight models exported abroad. Because open weights cannot be recalled or monitored, China's diffusion model makes US-style kill-switch safety debates irrelevant and its progress hard to observe.

insights.so_what: US lead on frontier models may not translate into economic or strategic advantage if diffusion is the real race.
